_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: Pearson Edexcel Level 3 Advanced GCE in History (9HI0) specification, Issue 3: the assessment structure and objectives, the Route B pairing (Paper 1 Option 1B and Paper 2 Option 2B.1) and Paper 3 Topic 31 content
_items_source.version: Issue 3 (the current specification, first teaching September 2015, unchanged for the papers taught here), linked from qualifications.pearson.com and itemised 2026-09-27
_items_source.numbering: Edexcel does not number the sub-bullets within each key topic, so this course codes them in the specification's own order: Paper 1 Option 1B by theme (1B.1-1B.4, with an unnumbered historical-interpretations topic coded 1B.INT); Paper 2 Option 2B.1 by key topic (2B1.KT1-2B1.KT4, each with its own sub-bullets .1, .2, ...); and Paper 3 Topic 31 by breadth theme and named case study (31.BREADTH.*, 31.CASE.*, with the two required in-depth studies coded 31.DEPTH.PILGRIMAGE and 31.DEPTH.KETT, and a final synoptic item 31.SYNTHESIS).
